resources.string: See when each sports facility is usually less busy and find a better time to exercise.
What would you like to do?
Some time slots may include club or school sessions.
Historical averages of SAF bookings (April–October 2026), computed from the app’s local database.
No data is available for this activity.
An estimate based on the SAF booking history. All calculations take place locally on your device.
SAF data workbook: “Spaces”, “General timetable” and “Bookings” sheets. The data is pre-processed and the app receives only aggregated counts by activity, day and time slot.
By default, the app uses April, May, June, September and October 2026 (teaching period). You can also consult the full period from April to October.

Gyms and swimming pools: average number of people with a booking overlapping the time slot, divided by capacity. Courts and pitches: average number of booked units divided by the number of available units. Long bookings count as occupied and may be marked as club or school sessions.
Quiet: below 50%. Moderate: from 50% to below 80%. Busy: 80% or more. An alternative is suggested only when it is at least 10 percentage points quieter than the selected time slot.
Shows usual occupancy (historical average), not real-time occupancy.
Counts bookings, not the people who actually attended.
Default period: April–June and September–October 2026; activity is much lower in July and August.
Courts are counted as occupied or available units; gyms and swimming pools are counted in people.
The data contains no personal identifiers: the app does not know who you are and does not personalize results.
Time slots with fewer than 8 observed days are marked as “limited data”.
Fitness room shift changes (10:00 and 15:00) do not have data.
Privacy: this app does not need an internet connection, contains no analytics and does not send data outside your device.

Data: historical averages for the teaching period (April–June and September–October 2026). Bookings are counted; this is not real-time occupancy.
At most one alternative of each kind is suggested: the quietest slot, if it is at least 10 percentage points quieter. Slots with few data are not suggested.
The SAF assistant: opening hours, occupancy and quieter times.
